g.text: One IAM role per function (infra/iam.ts → node-function.ts)
+ inline policy: only its own actions on its own resources
Other roles: Step Functions (invoke the 4 saga Lambdas, UpdateItem, PutEvents),
AppSync data sources, AppSync logs, GitHub preview / deploy (bootstrap/)
Resource policies: S3 bucket policies (SourceArn = our distribution) +
Block Public Access on both buckets, Lambda permissions (only our APIs / bucket),
SQS + SNS policies (only our EventBridge rules)
